name: PricePress – Advanced Dynamic Pricing and Discount Rules for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Unlock your store’s full potential with PricePress—the ultimate WooCommerce Dynamic Pricing and Discount Manager. Designed for performance and built with a modern React-based interface, PricePress empowers you to create complex pricing strategies that drive sales, clear stock, and reward customer loyalty.

🚀 Why PricePress is a MUST-HAVE for Every WooCommerce Store

Standard WooCommerce prices are static, but your customers aren’t. In today’s competitive e-commerce world, you need to be agile. PricePress turns your store into a professional pricing engine by allowing you to:
* Increase Average Order Value (AOV): Automatically reward customers who buy in bulk, turning a $20 order into a $100 order.
* Clear Inventory Faster: Use psychological BOGO triggers to move slow-moving stock effortlessly.
* Build Customer Loyalty: Offer category-wide discounts that keep shoppers coming back for the best deals.
* Make Data-Driven Decisions: Stop guessing! Our built-in analytics show you exactly which rules are generating revenue and which ones need adjustment.

Get the PRO version for Advanced Features & Analytics →

Features & Real-World Examples

  • ⚡ Unlimited Tiered Pricing (Volume Discounts):
    • Example: Buy 1-5 items for $10 each, Buy 6-10 items for $8 each, and Buy 11+ for only $6 each.
    • Example: 10% off when buying 5 items, 20% off when buying 10 items.
  • 🎁 Advanced BOGO Offers (Buy X Get Y):
    • Example: “Buy 2 Get 1 Free” — Ideal for gift shops or inventory clearing.
    • Example: “Buy a T-Shirt, Get a Hat at 50% Off.”
  • 🎯 Flexible Target Control:
    • Apply rules to your entire store, specific product categories (e.g., “All Shoes 20% Off”), or just individual products.
  • 📅 Intelligent Scheduling:
    • Example: Automate your “Black Friday” sale to start at midnight and end on Monday.
    • Example: Run a “Weekend Flash Sale” that only triggers on Saturdays and Sundays.
  • 📊 Insightful Analytics Dashboard:
    • Visualize your success with interactive charts showing Gross Revenue vs. Discount Costs.
    • Identify your “Star Products” — the items that perform best under promotional pricing.
  • 🚚 Smart Shipping Incentives:
    • Example: “Spend $50 more to unlock FREE SHIPPING.”
    • Proven to reduce cart abandonment by showing progress alerts on the product page.
  • 🎨 Modern React UI:
    • A lightning-fast, sleek interface built with Chakra UI. Manage multiple rules with simple drag-and-drop prioritization.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the pricepress-dynamic-pricing-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the PricePress menu in your WordPress dashboard to configure your first rule.
sections.faq:
Is PricePress compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Absolutely. PricePress is optimized for High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) for maximum speed.

Can I use it for wholesale pricing?

Yes! By setting fixed-price tiers for specific categories or products, you can easily create a professional wholesale pricing structure.

Does it support variable products?

Yes, you can target individual variations or the entire variable product with any rule.
